value.signature: fn marker_value (input : & [u8] , marker : & Marker) -> Result < MarkerValue , EncodingError >

review.body: { let value = canonical (input) ? ; if value != marker_projection (marker) ? { return Err (EncodingError :: Shape) ; } Ok (MarkerValue (value)) }
